requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer, targeting SMBs (5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, AMPV ~500 pages), offering lowest business TCO and powerful performance.
requirements.Rationale: Address gap in HP's portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment, retain SMB market share, and compete with emerging CISS solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: CISS technology integration, cost optimization, performance benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product launch with ink tank technology, lowest TCO compared to HP's business printers, meets SMB usage profile.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI features for productivity, scan workflow, and device manageability, including a consolidated SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Enhance ease of management for SMBs with limited IT resources, differentiate from competitors with AI-driven solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: SMB portal development, AI feature integration, device management tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal operational with AI-driven print/scan/support, validated by usability testing with SMB users.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design maintenance box to be customer-replaceable, reducing service intervention and downtime for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Minimize intervention, improve serviceability, and address new SMB segment use cases.
requirements.Dependencies: Service center support, maintenance box design, warranty policies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end users (office manager/generalist IT) with instructions, validated via field trials.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduce user error, improve reliability, and support sustainable supply chain.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink bottle design, printer compatibility checks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles accepted only by Magellan printers; tested for error prevention in user scenarios.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions & Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for device management and monitoring for non-PDL SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Enable advanced manageability and monitoring for SMBs, especially unmanaged/lightly managed environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal features available for non-PDL SKUs, verified via acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Speed & PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: Enhance speed for PDL SKUs (target: 25/20 min improvement) and ensure PDL/PS support.
requirements.Rationale: Meet performance expectations for SMBs and provide compatibility with professional workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified speed improvement and supports PDL/PS; validated via performance tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Demonstrate sustainability, meet regulatory requirements, and differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Printer design, sustainability features, certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Blue Angel certificate awarded for Magellan product line.

requirements.Title: Warranty Policy: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer warranty coverage for 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provide assurance to SMB customers, align with competitive offerings, and manage risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published and supported by HP service network; verified via customer documentation.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% RCP
requirements.Description: Ensure printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), surpassing competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Position HP as sustainability leader, meet customer demand for eco-friendly products.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain sourcing, manufacturing process, certification.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: RCP percentage validated by third-party audit; included in product documentation.

requirements.Title: Maintenance Free or Less Maintenance
requirements.Description: Design printer with minimal maintenance requirements and fewer parts to replace over its lifetime.
requirements.Rationale: Reduce downtime, increase reliability for SMBs, and differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance schedule reduced vs. traditional models; validated by lifecycle tests.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Enable Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) capabilities for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Support new business models, increase flexibility for SMBs, and align with HP strategic goals.
requirements.Dependencies: PaaS platform integration, billing system, device connectivity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printers operational within PaaS framework; verified by pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Support seamless mobile printing through HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Enable flexible printing workflows, address mobile-first SMB environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer recognized and operational in HP App; tested with SMB user scenarios.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enable proactive support, improve manageability for SMBs, and enhance product reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data available and actionable in SMB portal; validated by field tests.
